text:
These unmodified fonts are bundled to keep development and production
builds independent of Google Fonts responses. `next/font/local` serves them with
the application.

Sources in the [Google Fonts repository](https://github.com/google/fonts):

- [Plus Jakarta Sans](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/plusjakartasans)
- [JetBrains Mono](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/jetbrainsmono)
- [Instrument Serif](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/instrumentserif)
- [Space Grotesk](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/spacegrotesk)

Each font is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; the corresponding
license is included alongside its font file.

Price amounts use weight 875 of the bundled Inter variable font in
`public/fonts/inter/InterVariable.woff2`, loaded through `next/font/local`.
Its SIL Open Font License is included at `public/fonts/inter/OFL.txt`.
